findings.issue_summary: Silent Background Transfer: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
findings.evidence: Timber.plant(CrashlyticsTree()) called unconditionally in onCreate() when not in debug mode.
findings.recommendation: Add a prominent disclosure dialog on first app launch before initializing Crashlytics.

findings.issue_summary: User-Initiated Collection: Disclosure exempt, but must be declared in Play Store form.
findings.evidence: MainActivity fetches DigitalCredential containing family_name. CredentialVerifier.ts extracts name and given_name on the server.
findings.recommendation: Ensure NAME collection is declared in the Play Store Data Safety form.

findings.evidence: Requests Manifest.permission.CAMERA but does not transfer photo data off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required, data stays local.
